title: Associate Software Engineer
bullets: Built infrastructure for a Salesforce-to-S3 backup solution using Apache Spark, HashiCorp Vault, AWS S3, AWS ECS, Jenkins, and Python.
Created infrastructure supporting enterprise Automation Anywhere deployments using AWS EC2, Terraform, Jenkins, S3, and Artifactory.
Implemented production monitoring and observability using Datadog and the ELK stack.
Modernized on-premises batch workloads for AWS using Apache Spark, Jenkins, Chef, and CloudFormation.
Developed an automated solution using AWS CloudWatch and Lambda to maintain ECS clusters with current Amazon Machine Images.
Migrated more than half a dozen Teradata reporting workflows to Snowflake SQL.
Created Splunk dashboards and PagerDuty alerts to monitor production service health and surface operational failures.
Supported cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, data-processing workflows, and production troubleshooting in a regulated enterprise environment.

title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented infrastructure and automation supporting enterprise applications, data workflows, and internal technology platforms.
Contributed to the modernization of legacy and on-premises systems through cloud architecture, automated deployment, and managed AWS services.
Developed and maintained CI/CD workflows supporting repeatable application and infrastructure delivery.
Built monitoring and alerting capabilities to improve service visibility and detection of operational failures.
Investigated production issues across applications, infrastructure, data flows, and external service integrations.
Partnered with engineers and stakeholders to define technical requirements, sequence delivery, and resolve cross-system dependencies.
Contributed to architecture and implementation decisions for systems requiring security, scalability, reliability, and ongoing operational support.

title: Principal Associate Software Engineer
bullets: Led and contributed to the design and delivery of software and infrastructure initiatives within a large-scale enterprise technology environment.
Provided technical direction across application architecture, cloud services, deployment workflows, data integrations, and production reliability.
Coordinated delivery across engineering teams and stakeholders, translating business and operational requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
Evaluated system designs, implementation approaches, operational risks, and deployment strategies for enterprise services.
Supported the development and troubleshooting of distributed applications and cloud-hosted workloads.
Promoted engineering practices focused on automation, observability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.
Mentored engineers through architecture discussions, implementation reviews, debugging, and delivery planning.
